mechanics.name: Passive - Call of the Freljord
mechanics.value: Damaging a champion, large monster or structure grants Nunu and one nearby ally 20% AS and 10% MS for 4 s, prioritising the highest-AS ally; max remaining duration 44 s

mechanics.name: Q - Consume vs champions
mechanics.value: 60/100/140/180/220 (+65% AP) (+5% bonus HP) magic damage; heal is only 60% of that; camps heal far more, so Q a camp/minion over a champion when a fight allows

mechanics.name: W - Biggest Snowball Ever!
mechanics.value: 50-70 mana, 14 s CD, rolls up to 10 s; min damage 36/45/54/63/72 (+30% AP), max 180/225/270/315/360 (+150% AP); knockup 0.5-0.75 s then stun 0-0.75 s by charge; disabled for the first 15 s of the game

mechanics.name: E - Snowball Barrage
mechanics.value: 50-70 mana, CD 14/13/12/11/10; per hit 15/22.5/30/37.5/45 (+12% AP); 9 hits max (3 volleys) = 405 base (+108% AP) total; 3 hits slow and Snowbound targets root for 0.5-1.62 s 3 s after the first cast

mechanics.name: E AP arithmetic (audit correction)
mechanics.value: 9 hits x 12% AP = +108% AP max; the older '+135% AP' figure was an arithmetic error and must not be repeated

mechanics.name: R - Absolute Zero
mechanics.value: 100 mana, CD 110/100/90, channel up to 3 s, radius 650; shield 65/75/85 (+150% AP) (+30/40/50% bonus HP); max damage 625/950/1275 (+300% AP); Flash/Teleport/Recall/Hexflash interrupt and auto-detonate the channel (Flash first, then R)

mechanics.name: Skill order
mechanics.value: Q > E > W; max Q first (rank 5 Q = 1200 monster true damage); R at 6/11/16

mechanics.name: Smite stages
mechanics.value: Flat, not level-based: Smite 600 true damage, Unleashed Smite 1000 after 15 pet treats, Primal Smite 1400 after 35 treats; 15 s CD, 90 s recharge, max 2 charges

mechanics.name: Dark Harvest
mechanics.value: 30 (+11 per soul) (+10% bonus AD) (+5% AP); triggers below 50% max HP only; 35 s CD, resets to 1 s on takedown; Liandry's burn is proc damage and does NOT trigger it

mechanics.name: Dragon timers and HP
mechanics.value: First elemental drake spawns 5:00, respawns every 5:00; soul is a team's 4th elemental drake, then Elder on a 6:00 timer; elemental drake HP 5106.25-10000 by level

mechanics.name: Voidgrubs and Herald
mechanics.value: Voidgrubs 8:00-14:45, single spawn, 3 grubs at 2269-4700 HP; Rift Herald 15:00-19:45 at 11718-18900 HP

mechanics.name: Camp and scuttle timers
mechanics.value: Small camps respawn 2:15, buffs 5:00; first scuttler 2:55, respawn 2:30, first scuttlers have 35% reduced HP

mechanics.name: Dragon Slayer damage reduction vs true damage
mechanics.value: Elemental drakes gain 15% damage reduction per Dragon Slayer stack (up to 60% at 4 stacks), but whether that reduction applies to Q/Smite true damage is NOT established; no reduced secure threshold is published here

mechanics.name: Zeke's Convergence tick total
mechanics.value: Frostfire Tempest hits for 30 magic damage every 0.25 s for 5 s (up to 600 by raw arithmetic), but the real number of damaging ticks is not verified - never quote a fixed total

itemNotes.name: Liandry's Torment
itemNotes.note: 3000 g, 60 AP, 300 HP; 1% max HP burn per 0.5 s over 3 s = 6% max HP, capped at 120 vs monsters; Suffering +2% damage per second up to +6%; modern Liandry's has no slow-based amplification

itemNotes.name: Rylai's Crystal Scepter
itemNotes.note: 2600 g, 65 AP, 400 HP; ability damage slows 30% for 1 s; does not extend or amplify Liandry's burn; no dedicated damage passive (its AP still scales ratios); situational stickiness pick, not a default

itemNotes.name: Defensive item picks
itemNotes.note: Spirit Visage 2700 g (+25% healing/shields), Kaenic Rookern 2900 g (80 MR, 15% max HP shield vs burst magic), Force of Nature 2800 g (8 stacks to +70 MR vs sustained magic), Zhonya's Hourglass 3250 g (2.5 s stasis)

itemNotes.name: Dark Seal and Mejai's
itemNotes.note: Dark Seal 350 g, +4 AP per stack up to 10, lose 5 on death; Mejai's 1500 g, +5 AP per stack up to 25, lose 10 on death; skip Mejai's when deaths are stacking

itemNotes.name: Grievous Wounds
itemNotes.note: 40% reduced healing; Oblivion Orb 800 g applies it on magic damage; Morellonomicon 2850 g upgrades it

itemNotes.name: Boot win-rate comparison
itemNotes.note: op.gg current patch: Plated Steelcaps 55.03% WR (33.37% pick) vs Sorcerer's Shoes 50.17% (28.53%); raw win-rate comparison with undisclosed sample/rank - not causal and not matchup-specific

itemNotes.name: Sampled core builds
itemNotes.note: op.gg cores are tiny samples (13/22/27 games) with selection bias (winning players pick items); treat as hypotheses to test, never as unconditional advice

decisionRules.rule: At a drake spawn, start the dragon when the enemy jungler shows top AND you have pit vision plus lane priority; otherwise do not blind-start it
preconditions: lane priority or lanes cannot collapse

decisionRules.rule: Secure window uses your actual Smite stage: base Smite adds 600, Unleashed adds 1000, Primal adds 1400; with Unleashed, L6 = 800+1000 = 1800 and L9 = 1200+1000 = 2200
preconditions: Smite stage confirmed from pet treats (15/35)

decisionRules.rule: Do not call a concrete secure number on your 2nd/3rd drake; treat effective burst as unknown because the Dragon Slayer reduction interaction is unverified
preconditions: attacking team already has at least one elemental drake

decisionRules.rule: If they have 2+ Heartsteel stackers, buy Liandry's before Rylai's; also deny Heartsteel stacks by breaking 700-unit contact
preconditions: 2+ enemy Heartsteel holders or HP stackers

decisionRules.rule: If they have a fed AP burst mage, take Zhonya's after core; remember every item active except Shurelya's, Youmuu's and Randuin's interrupts your R channel
preconditions: R channel is part of the plan

decisionRules.rule: If they have 2+ auto-attack carries and you are not snowballing, Plated Steelcaps is the reasonable default over Sorcerer's Shoes; take Sorcs only when snowballing or when AP burst is needed
preconditions: supporting win-rate data is not causal

decisionRules.rule: Match defensive MR to threat type: Kaenic Rookern vs burst magic, Force of Nature vs sustained magic (Cassiopeia/Swain/Ryze)
preconditions: enemy magic threat can be classified as burst vs sustained

decisionRules.rule: If they have 2+ healers, buy Oblivion Orb (800 g) by first back and finish Morellonomicon by mid-game; every Nunu ability applies Grievous Wounds on magic damage
If you died 2+ times before 8:00, skip Mejai's and stabilise on Voidgrubs and scuttle instead
preconditions: death count and game clock observed

decisionRules.rule: If the enemy jungler dies or shows opposite side between 8:00 and 14:45, take Voidgrubs; Q rank 4 plus Unleashed Smite is about 88% of a 2269 HP grub
Teamfight combo: charged W from fog (0.75 s knockup + up to 0.75 s stun), then E to root, then full-channel R on the clustered backline; Flash first, then R
preconditions: key point-and-click interrupts are down or unknown

decisionRules.rule: If 2+ levels behind at a drake spawn, prefer to give it and play the Herald timer instead; this is a risk-preference rule, not a proven 'cannot out-secure' fact
Do not contest an objective without a Smite charge, with R down, or with no vision/priority; Nunu re-enters on the 2:15/5:00 camp cycles instead of flipping blind
preconditions: Smite charges, R cooldown and vision state are known

decisionRules.rule: A failed gank should be treated as an unquantified opportunity cost; do not claim it equals a full camp cycle as if measured

counters.name: Heartsteel
counters.note: Break 700-unit contact to deny stacks; Liandry's 6% max HP burn + Suffering scales against their HP; Abyssal Mask aura adds 12% team magic damage onto them

counters.name: Blackfire Torch
counters.note: Its burn amplifies enemy mages; buy MR (Rookern/Spirit Visage) and kill the holder first with W+E into R; do not group tightly while it ticks

counters.name: Youmuu's Ghostblade
counters.note: Lethality assassin: Zhonya's and Plated Steelcaps blunt the burst; catch them with W slow/knockup and E root; force Wraith Step before committing R

counters.name: Kraken Slayer
counters.note: Missing-HP on-hit shreds you low: Plated Steelcaps (-10% basic damage), attack-speed slows, and Zhonya's for the third-hit window; kill the marksman with a full-channel R

counters.name: Zeke's Convergence
counters.note: Frostfire Tempest is a 350-radius zone for 5 s on a 45 s CD tied to their ultimate; channel R from outside 350 units or after the storm ends

counters.name: Locket of the Iron Solari
counters.note: Force the active with poke, wait out the 2.5 s decaying shield, then re-engage inside the 90 s CD; the shield is centred on the holder and covers allies within 850, so your spacing does not reduce its target count

counters.name: Solstice Sleigh
counters.note: It triggers when the HOLDER slows or immobilises an enemy (not when your W/E slows them); expect +50-230 effective HP on the support and their most-wounded ally; re-engage after the 30 s CD
